mail.subject: Re: An investigator is asking about you
body: You stay home for a week. Heat cools a little.

mail.subject: A sketch in the paper
body: SportsWire has a sketch of Hector Reyes (groundskeeper). It is accurate.

mail.subject: Notice of inquiry
body: The Office is aware of irregularities at the Lamplighters game of Sun, April 7, 1996. An inquiry is open. Persons with knowledge are encouraged to call the hotline (1-800-555-0144).

mail.subject: We know
body: The Lamplighters know who you are. We have your fax number.
There will not be a second letter.

mail.subject: Report: Blackmail a player
body: Blackmail a player: failed.
Final: ELC 1, HCL 4. The Lamplighters won anyway.

mail.subject: We have hired some people
body: We have posted men at the gates and in the tunnels of every club owned by the Haldane Organization. They have your description.
They are paid by the hour. They have nothing else to do.

mail.subject: Your photograph
body: Your crew's photographs are now taped inside every ticket booth at Bellwood Park.
The ushers have been told. The bleachers are closed to you until further notice.

mail.subject: Report: Bribe the umpire
body: Bribe the umpire: failed.
Final: CSR 4, STA 0. The Friars lost.

mail.subject: You won $107
body: Final: ELC 11, HCL 1.
You had $60 on the away side.
Paid out: $107.

mail.subject: Tough luck
body: Final: BVG 6, SBS 8.
You had $30 on the away side.
Better luck tomorrow.

mail.subject: You won $199
body: Final: CSR 2, STA 9.
You had $100 on the home side.
Paid out: $199.

mail.subject: Report: Grease the mound
body: Grease the mound: failed.
Final: CSR 2, STA 9. The Rustlers lost.

mail.subject: Blackmail a player: did not work
body: Hector Reyes could not get past the Lamplighters night watchman. The job is off.
No one saw anything, as far as we know.

mail.subject: Heads up
body: Frank Mullane and a teammate are not speaking. The Prospectors clubhouse is quiet.
Burn this.

mail.subject: FYI
body: Tom Zaleski and a teammate are not speaking. The Friars clubhouse is quiet.
Burn this.

mail.subject: Bribe the umpire: did not work
body: The umpire took "Dutch" Kowalski's envelope, counted it and handed it back. He said he would think about it.
No one saw anything, as far as we know.

mail.subject: Grease the mound: did not work
body: Quincy Watanabe could not get past the Rustlers night watchman. The job is off.
No one saw anything, as far as we know.

mail.subject: Dotty Dial chipped in $20
body: Dotty Dial paid $20 toward "Grease the mound". It has been credited to you.

mail.subject: Sold for $120
body: Gus Gumshoe bought your card.
After the house's 5% you got $114.

mail.subject: Welcome to the league
body: Here's $1,000 and a free starter pack. Spend it wisely, or don't.
Games air every half hour. Bets close at first pitch.
Remember: nothing in this league is fixed. Officially.
